title: scct.map-authoring version 1 (snapshot, summary)
description: The Map JSON export of View > Export Map to JSON... and the bridge op authoring.export (streamed to a blob; ShipD is about 42 MB, so prefer map_query and authoring.schema for routine reads). Reference information only: import a scct.map-changes document (scct://schema/map-changes), never the snapshot. This schema describes the shape; per-class property schemas come from the live editor and describe types and enum choices, not class defaults.

map.description: Destination identity: the canonical path of a saved map, or a session identity (unsaved:*) for an unsaved one. Copy it into change files exactly.

level.description: Native object-path prefix of the level, such as MyLevel.

actors.description: Every authorable actor (LevelInfo, the builder brush and cameras excluded), then the particle components they own.

classes.description: Loaded, non-abstract actor classes (sorted by class path) and particle-emitter component classes, each with its property schema.

category.description: Events, Sounds, Triggers, Movers, Emitters, Volumes or Other.

brush.description: A Brush subclass: create it with geometry box or polygons.

assets.description: Loaded assets by type. Load more packages and export again when one is missing.

geometryT3d.description: Native T3D text of the map's actors and brushes, for spatial context (meshes refer to their assets; no mesh vertex data).

geometryUnavailable.description: Why geometryT3d could not be produced.

changes.description: An empty scct.map-changes template carrying the right map identity (version 3).

value.description: Exported values: string leaves (numbers "64", bools "True"/"False", enums bare, text JSON-quoted, references Class'MyLevel.Name' or None), structs as objects, arrays as arrays.

category.description: The editor property category (on actor schemas).

fields.description: StructProperty fields; a value must supply every one.

inner.description: Element schema of an ArrayProperty or FixedArray.

type.description: Declared class of an ObjectProperty or ClassProperty.

values.description: Complete exposed values: copy them whole into update.before or delete.before.

unavailable.description: Properties that could not be read, with the reason.

bounds.description: Static meshes: local bounding box [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ].
